_doc: Catalog of every prompt to review. Each entry has: repo (ours|claude-code-src|openclaw|hermes-agent|codex|prime-agent|kimi-code), path (relative to repo root), id (stable name — variable name, function, or basename), category, summary, keywords. The build script extracts text using id (regex anchor) with line-range as fallback. To add a prompt, append to the relevant list — no schema changes needed.
